methodology.skyOverride: Installed when __game is assigned, before first game RAF. Original sky.update runs each frame with dt=0 and elapsed=0 or 78; timeOffset=0. Firefly origin fixed to train center. No source edits.
methodology.gaugeOverride: Page-only constant getter/setters prevent gauge drift; train/player/world animation and normal render loop remain live.
methodology.setup: Stand, undock, reset train, set exact station x/level/y/z=0.35/facing=1; native rig follows without custom inhabit zoom. Cab enters through normal automatic interaction.
methodology.settle: At least 2500ms live RAF, no camera transition/soft ease, expired toast (including CSS fade), then verify mode, pose, sky, quality, focus and UI.
methodology.performance: One visible foreground page at a time. Native RAF timestamp intervals; discard 30 intervals, retain 180 per daytime station. No manual renderer calls, synthetic clock, screenshots, scene traversal or CDP requests during sampling. sky.renderer.info render counters read each retained frame.
methodology.resourceScope: Unique geometry/material object references across car groups, explicitly pruning player.group even when docked; separate train-owned totals include routeGroup and smoke sprites. Scene/train lights include total, effectively visible, positive intensity and shadow casters.
methodology.exterior: Real reading-seat interaction enters book mode, seals walls, retains book UI. Held side theta=-PI/2 and rear three-quarter theta=5PI/4, phi=0.26. Distance=max(55,28/(tan(21deg)*aspect)), capped at native book maximum 130. Never labelled inhabit.
methodology.screenshots: Full page, DPR1, UI intact, fonts ready, no CSS injection or hidden overlays. Transient toasts expire naturally.
limitations: Touch profiles emulate viewport and coarse pointer, not physical mobile GPU/CPU or thermal behavior.
RAF timings are display-paced end-to-end intervals, not isolated CPU/GPU render durations; counters include the normal renderer shadow work.
Only sky and gauges are frozen. Native idle breathing, fire flicker and world animation remain live; pixel-perfect image identity is not guaranteed.
Portrait book side view reaches native zoom limit 130 and may crop train ends; native inhabit framing is intentionally not widened.
Sky dt=0 suppresses cloud drift, meteor progression and firefly lag; this same page-only condition must be used for after measurements.
